correctness.rationale: Projecting a flag to its line and hyperplane realizes the fivefold as a projective-line bundle over the complete intersection \(Y\subset\mathbf P(V)\times\mathbf P(V^*)\) cut out by \(\phi(v)=\phi(Sv)=0\). Linear dependence of the two differentials is equivalent to \((S-\lambda I)v=0\) and \(\phi(S-\lambda I)=0\), hence \(\lambda=\pm1\) and exactly two singular base curves occur. Lifting the intermediate two-plane gives a second projective line, so each singular component is \(\mathbf P^1\times\mathbf P^1\). In affine coordinates the two base equations reduce to one smooth coordinate and \(py+qz=0\); the projective-line bundle adds one further smooth coordinate, giving the claimed transverse threefold node. Codimension-three singular locus plus hypersurface/Cohen–Macaulay local structure gives normality.
